opportunity_name: CyberDyne Systems ISO 27001:2022 & PCI-DSS 4.0 Compliance Audit & Governance Framework
rfp_text: CyberDyne Systems requires an end-to-end compliance readiness audit for ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls and PCI-DSS 4.0 requirement compliance across cloud infrastructure. Scope includes control gap matrix generation, SOC 2 Type II readiness assessment, third-party vendor risk policy drafting, and executive risk briefing presentation to board members.
